natural: the emperor's own sword

meaning.en: In old China, a sword bestowed by the emperor that let its bearer act first and report later; today, a special authority or backing that lets one act freely.
meaning.zh: 旧时皇帝赐给大臣、可先斩后奏的宝剑；现比喻上级授予的特殊权力或有力的靠山。

examples.zh: 总经理给了他尚方宝剑，让他放手整顿部门。
examples.en: The general manager gave him carte blanche to overhaul the department.

examples.zh: 别以为手握尚方宝剑就可以为所欲为。
examples.en: Don't think holding special authority lets you do whatever you like.

usage.en: Usually figurative, in work and politics; can be neutral or sarcastic depending on tone. Object of 手持/手握.
usage.zh: 多用作比喻，见于职场和政治语境，褒贬视语气而定。常作“手持/手握”的宾语。

literal: raise to · principle · raise to · line
natural: raise it to the level of principle

meaning.en: To blow a minor fault or difference up into a matter of principle or politics.
meaning.zh: 把小问题、小分歧夸大为原则问题或政治问题。

equivalents: make a federal case of it

examples.zh: 一点小失误，没必要上纲上线。
examples.en: A small mistake doesn't need to be blown out of proportion.

examples.zh: 他总爱把同事的意见上纲上线，大家都不敢说话了。
examples.en: He always inflates colleagues' opinions into matters of principle, and nobody dares to speak.

usage.en: Associated with political campaigns of the 1950s-70s; now a criticism of overreaction. Often 不要/别上纲上线.
usage.zh: 与二十世纪五至七十年代的政治运动有关，现多批评小题大做。常说“不要/别上纲上线”。

natural: cut the robe and sever the bond

meaning.en: To break off a friendship or sworn brotherhood for good, symbolically cutting one's robe.
meaning.zh: 割断衣袍，表示与朋友或结义兄弟彻底断绝关系。

examples.zh: 两人为利益闹翻，当众割袍断义。
examples.en: The two fell out over money and publicly severed their bond.

examples.zh: 多年的朋友竟然割袍断义，令人唏嘘。
examples.en: It is sad that old friends should cut all ties like that.

usage.en: Often in stories of sworn brotherhood; literary. Compare 割席断交.
usage.zh: 常见于结义故事，书面语。可与“割席断交”比较。

literal: elder brother · younger brother · harmonious · harmonious
natural: brothers living in harmony

meaning.en: Brothers getting along well with warmth and ease.
meaning.zh: 兄弟之间和睦愉快，相处融洽。

examples.zh: 这一家兄弟怡怡，让邻里羡慕。
examples.en: The brothers of this family get along so well that the neighbours envy them.

examples.zh: 父母最大的心愿，是看到兄弟怡怡，家和万事兴。
examples.en: Parents' greatest wish is to see their sons in harmony; a peaceful home brings success in everything.

story.en: Confucius told Zilu that a true scholar is earnest with friends and harmonious with brothers: '朋友切切偲偲，兄弟怡怡'.
story.zh: 《论语·子路》：“切切偲偲，怡怡如也，可谓士矣。朋友切切偲偲，兄弟怡怡。”

usage.en: Literary praise of sibling harmony; 怡怡 is read yí yí.
usage.zh: 书面语，赞美兄弟和睦；“怡怡”读 yí yí。

natural: hide it and not show it

meaning.en: To keep one's talent, feelings or intentions hidden rather than showing them off.
meaning.zh: 把才能、感情或意图藏起来，不表现出来。

equivalents: play one's cards close to the chest

examples.zh: 他有真本事，却一直藏而不露。
examples.en: He has real ability but always kept it to himself.

examples.zh: 老板对人事安排藏而不露，大家都猜不透。
examples.en: The boss kept the personnel plans to himself, and nobody could guess them.

usage.en: Neutral; can be praise (modesty) or a note of caution (secretiveness). Here 露 is read lù, as in 暴露/显露.
usage.zh: 中性，可赞谦虚，也可指深藏心机。此处“露”读 lù。

literal: drill into · it · ever more · hard
natural: the deeper one drills, the harder it is

meaning.en: The more one probes something, the harder and deeper it proves; said in praise of profound learning, or of tasks that demand persistence.
meaning.zh: 越钻研越觉得坚实高深，形容学问精深，也指需要持之以恒。

equivalents: the deeper you go, the deeper it gets
ever more profound on closer study

examples.zh: 这门学问钻之弥坚，越学越觉得自己知道得少。
examples.en: This field gets deeper the more you probe it, and the more I learn the less I feel I know.

examples.zh: 他对老师的学问仰之弥高，钻之弥坚。
examples.en: He looked up to his teacher's learning as ever higher and found it ever more profound.

story.en: Yan Yuan sighed about Confucius' way: 'The more I look up at it, the higher it seems; the more I drill into it, the harder it is' (仰之弥高，钻之弥坚).
story.zh: 颜渊喟然叹曰：“仰之弥高，钻之弥坚。瞻之在前，忽焉在后。”

usage.en: Usually paired with 仰之弥高; a respectful, literary phrase for teachers. 钻 is read zuān ('drill'), not zuàn.
usage.zh: 常与“仰之弥高”连用，是对师长学问的敬语，书面语。“钻”读 zuān，不读 zuàn。

natural: white sand in black mud

meaning.en: A person in a bad environment is gradually corrupted by it, just as white sand in black mud turns black.
meaning.zh: 白沙混在黑泥里也会变黑，比喻人处在坏的环境中会受到不良影响。

equivalents: a bad apple spoils the barrel

examples.zh: 他进了那个圈子，白沙在涅，慢慢染上了坏习惯。
examples.en: After joining that crowd he gradually picked up bad habits, like white sand in black mud.

examples.zh: 家长担心孩子白沙在涅，所以特别注意他交什么朋友。
examples.en: Parents worry that a child may be corrupted, so they watch carefully whom he befriends.

story.en: Xunzi: 'Mugwort growing among hemp stands up straight without support; white sand in black mud turns black with it' (蓬生麻中，不扶而直；白沙在涅，与之俱黑).
story.zh: 《荀子·劝学》：“蓬生麻中，不扶而直；白沙在涅，与之俱黑。”

usage.en: The negative counterpart of 蓬生麻中; the full line is 白沙在涅，与之俱黑. Literary; 涅 is read niè.
usage.zh: 与“蓬生麻中”相对，完整的一句是“白沙在涅，与之俱黑”。书面语；“涅”读 niè。

natural: to win a name for nothing

meaning.en: To have a reputation one does not deserve.
meaning.zh: 获得了与实际不符的名声，名不副实。

equivalents: a name that is not earned

examples.zh: 这家老字号味道一般，真是浪得虚名。
examples.en: This old brand tastes ordinary; its fame is undeserved.

examples.zh: 他不甘心浪得虚名，决心拿出真本事。
examples.en: He refused to hold an undeserved reputation and was determined to show real ability.

usage.en: Often used as a self-deprecating remark (不敢浪得虚名) or a criticism. Predicate.
usage.zh: 常作自谦（不敢浪得虚名）或批评。作谓语。

natural: a petty man in poverty runs wild

meaning.en: A petty person, once in hardship, will do anything, while a gentleman keeps to his principles.
meaning.zh: 品德低下的人一旦陷入困境，就会胡作非为；君子则坚守节操。

equivalents: a mean man in hardship loses all restraint
hardship brings out the worst in a petty man

examples.zh: 孔子说小人穷斯滥，提醒人们困境中更要守住底线。
examples.en: Confucius said that the petty man in poverty runs wild, a reminder to keep one's limits especially in hard times.

examples.zh: 人在困境中才见品性，小人穷斯滥，君子固穷。
examples.en: Character shows in hardship: the petty man in need runs wild, while the gentleman endures it.

story.en: Stranded without food in Chen, Zilu asked angrily if a gentleman could also be poor. Confucius replied: 'A gentleman is certainly steadfast in poverty; a petty man in poverty runs wild' (君子固穷，小人穷斯滥矣).
story.zh: 陈国绝粮，子路愠见曰：“君子亦有穷乎？”子曰：“君子固穷，小人穷斯滥矣。”

usage.en: Usually in contrast with 君子固穷; the original line ends with 矣. Literary; maxim.
usage.zh: 多与“君子固穷”对举，原文句末有“矣”。书面语，格言。

natural: a brush with the force of thirty thousand catties

meaning.en: Of writing or calligraphy: extremely forceful and powerful.
meaning.zh: 形容文章或书法有力，气势雄健。

examples.zh: 这幅字笔力千钧，一看就是名家手笔。
examples.en: This piece of calligraphy has great force and was clearly written by a master.

examples.zh: 他的评论文章笔力千钧，一针见血。
examples.en: His commentary is forceful and goes straight to the point.

usage.en: Praise for calligraphy, prose and drawing. 钧 is an old weight (about 30 jin). Literary; predicate or attributive.
usage.zh: 称赞书法、文章、绘画有力度。“钧”是古代重量单位（约三十斤）。书面语，作谓语、定语。

natural: borrow a hen to lay eggs

meaning.en: To use someone else's resources, capital or platform to make one's own profit.
meaning.zh: 借用别人的资源、资金或平台来为自己赚钱。

examples.zh: 他借鸡生蛋，用银行贷款办起了自己的工厂。
examples.en: He used bank loans to set up his own factory, building on other people's money.

examples.zh: 借鸡生蛋也要讲信用，不能让出借方吃亏。
examples.en: Even when using someone else's resources, you must keep your word and not let the lender lose out.

usage.en: Can be admiring (shrewd) or critical (opportunistic), by tone. Casual; predicate.
usage.zh: 视语气可含赞赏（精明）或批评（取巧）。口语，作谓语。

natural: to return with nothing accomplished

meaning.en: To come back without achieving anything.
meaning.zh: 没有取得成果就回来了。

examples.zh: 谈判团队奔波一周，最后无功而返。
examples.en: The negotiating team travelled for a week and in the end came back with nothing.

examples.zh: 我们爬到半山腰就遇上暴雨，只好无功而返。
examples.en: We met heavy rain halfway up the mountain and had to turn back with nothing achieved.

usage.en: Neutral report of a failed trip or mission. Predicate.
usage.zh: 中性地叙述未达成目的。作谓语。

natural: drink the water and forget its source

meaning.en: To forget those to whom one owes one's present happiness or success.
meaning.zh: 忘了自己幸福、成功的来源，不知感恩。

examples.zh: 他发达以后饮水忘源，连老同学都不认了。
examples.en: After he made it big he forgot where he came from and no longer acknowledged his old classmates.

examples.zh: 做人不能饮水忘源。
examples.en: One must not forget the source of one's good fortune.

usage.en: The negative counterpart of 饮水思源. Predicate; a moral reproach.
usage.zh: 与“饮水思源”相反，作谓语，用于道德批评。

literal: broken · jade tablet · remaining · jade disc
natural: a broken tablet and a chipped disc

meaning.en: Fragments of precious things, especially surviving fragments of an ancient work or art.
meaning.zh: 残缺的珍贵物品，多指流传下来的古代文字、艺术品的残片。

examples.zh: 这些断圭残璧般的手稿，是研究那位诗人的珍贵资料。
examples.en: These manuscript fragments are precious material for studying the poet.

examples.zh: 出土的断圭残璧，让我们窥见了当年的辉煌。
examples.en: The unearthed fragments give us a glimpse of its former glory.

usage.en: Literary, for ancient texts and relics. 圭 is read guī. Predicate or attributive.
usage.zh: 书面语，多指古代文献、文物残片。“圭”读 guī。作谓语、定语。

natural: scattered pearls and bits of jade

meaning.en: Short, scattered but precious pieces of writing or sayings.
meaning.zh: 零散而珍贵的短小文字或言论。

examples.zh: 这本小册子收了他生前的零玑碎玉。
examples.en: This booklet collects the scattered gems he wrote during his lifetime.

examples.zh: 读他的随笔，像在拾零玑碎玉，处处有惊喜。
examples.en: Reading his essays is like picking up scattered gems, full of delightful surprises.

usage.en: Praise for brief jottings and aphorisms; literary. 玑 is read jī.
usage.zh: 称赞简短的随笔、警句；书面语。“玑”读 jī。

natural: the word is spoken and the law follows

meaning.en: Rules or orders take effect as soon as they are announced and are enforced without delay.
meaning.zh: 一经说出，就立即成为法令并得到执行；也指话一说就成真。

examples.zh: 新规做到言出法随，违规者一律处罚。
examples.en: The new rules are enforced as soon as they are announced, and every offender is punished.

examples.zh: 法治社会要做到言出法随，令行禁止。
examples.en: A society ruled by law should enforce its rules as soon as they are announced.

usage.en: Common in news and official writing; in fantasy fiction it can mean a spoken word that takes effect at once. Formal.
usage.zh: 常见于新闻和公文；在玄幻小说中也指话一出口就成真。书面语。

natural: so heartbroken as to die

meaning.en: Extremely sad, so heartbroken that one can hardly go on.
meaning.zh: 伤心到了极点，几乎要活不下去。

examples.zh: 听到噩耗，她伤心欲绝，哭倒在地。
examples.en: On hearing the terrible news she collapsed in tears, utterly heartbroken.

examples.zh: 宠物走了，孩子伤心欲绝。
examples.en: When the pet died, the child was heartbroken.

usage.en: Predicate or complement; stronger than 伤心. Neutral.
usage.zh: 作谓语、补语，比“伤心”程度更重。中性语体。

natural: to break the law while enforcing it

meaning.en: Said of those who are responsible for enforcing the law yet break it themselves.
meaning.zh: 负责执行法律的人自己却违反法律。

examples.zh: 执法犯法的人，应该罪加一等。
examples.en: Those who break the law while enforcing it should receive heavier punishment.

examples.zh: 这名警察执法犯法，被依法开除。
examples.en: The officer broke the law while enforcing it and was dismissed according to the law.

usage.en: Criticism of abuse of position in news and legal writing. Formal; attributive or predicate.
usage.zh: 批评滥用职权，多见于新闻和法律文书。书面语，作定语、谓语。

literal: as if · sitting in · clouds · mist
natural: as if sitting in clouds and mist

meaning.en: Utterly bewildered, with no idea what is going on, as if sitting in a thick fog.
meaning.zh: 像坐在云雾里一样，头脑迷糊，摸不着头绪。

examples.zh: 他讲了半天专业术语，我听得如坐云雾。
examples.en: He used technical terms for ages and I listened in a complete fog.

examples.zh: 对这个新系统，大家都如坐云雾。
examples.en: Everyone is completely confused by the new system.

usage.en: Usually 如坐云雾 or 如坐云雾中. Describes bewilderment; can also mean a floating, dizzy feeling. Predicate.
usage.zh: 常说“如坐云雾”或“如坐云雾中”，形容迷茫；也可形容飘飘然、头晕。作谓语。

natural: try the blade a little

meaning.en: To show one's ability for the first time, on a small scale.
meaning.zh: 初次小规模地显露才能。

examples.zh: 新人在这次活动中小试锋芒，表现不俗。
examples.en: The newcomer showed his mettle at this event and did well.

examples.zh: 这次小试锋芒，让他赢得了领导的信任。
examples.en: This first show of his ability won him the leader's trust.

usage.en: Often used of newcomers' first successes; positive. Predicate.
usage.zh: 多指新人初次小显身手，含褒义。作谓语。
